title: Coeur Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
summary: Coeur Mining, Inc. (“Coeur” or the “Company”) (NYSE, TSX: CDE) today announced that it will report its second quarter 2026 operational and financial results after the New York Stock Exchange closes for trading on Wednesday, August 5, 2026. The Company will be hosting a conference call at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time (10:00 a.m. Central Time) on Thursday, August 6, 2026. Hosting the call will be Mitchell J. Krebs, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of Coeur, who will be joined by Thomas S. Whelan, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Michael “Mick” Routledge, Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, and other members of management. A replay of the call will be available through August 13, 2026.
